result.summary: Found 1 minor layout issue: the first card's delivery-time badge in 'Fastest near you' is misaligned compared with the other cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the '15–25 min' badge on the first card (Green Bowl Poké) is not bottom-aligned like the time badges on the adjacent cards, making the row look inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Position the delivery-time badge consistently at the bottom-left of the image area for all carousel cards.
